note: Level 5 of the hierarchical rule model (RULE_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.md Section 6). Maps each concern domain to the atomic rules (RULE_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.csv) that COULD theoretically contribute to it if fully implemented and validated -- 27 of DOAR's 41 rules are DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE and cannot fire at all today (see RULE_COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv), so 'candidate' here means 'source material proposes this construct', never 'currently produces this output'. No domain in this file is reachable in production today. A depicted sad face supports 'negative depicted affect' -- it does not, on its own or in combination with these other unvalidated rules, support 'the child is depressed' as a stated fact; every clinician-facing hypothesis wording example below is a HYPOTHESIS phrase for future decision-support use, not a claim this session generated for any real case.
